text:
sam: heads-up: sudden NVMe write fanout on scratch-us-east1-b. GPUs are stuck in attach pending with high attach latencies (~2m). noticed at ~2026-03-23T09:15Z.

sam: alert metrics: scratch_iops_p99=365k, small_write_ratio=0.78, janitor_pending=520

opsbot: [ALERT] scratch-us-east1-b local-nvme write surge. Playbook: https://runbooks/redwood/scratch-iops.

claire: did anything deploy in that region overnight?

sam: we rolled scrub tuning (v3) at 03:40Z, and a tenant backfill job started at 09:12Z. timing matches.

vik: can we short-circuit janitor for the hot cohort? we have per-cohort rate knobs.

leo: cost quick note: if we divert traffic to dedicated for affected customers, we'll pay for extra reserved capacity and might incur throttles on other pools. short-term cost ~1.5k/hr if we cold-start 4 extra dedicated nodes.

claire: prefer to throttle janitor first. last time lowering to 40r/s helped. also, add a temporary schedule to avoid scrub overlapping with big backfills.

vik: RTE to apply:
```bash
curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/pools/scratch-us-east1-b/janitor -d '{"rate":30}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
I'll run it in 30s.

sam: executing patch now. disabling spot-autoscale for 15m to avoid more attach churn.

opsbot: action log: janitor rate set to 30 r/s by vik at 2026-03-23T09:18:10Z. spot-autoscale disabled for 15m by sam.

sam: iostat snapshot after throttle (filtered):
```
Device: r/s w/s rsec/s wsec/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1: 48.00 6500.00 380.00 260000.00 760 52000 16.2 0.95 0.11 0.98 71.3
```

sam: janitor_pending: 520 -> 78 within 4m. attach latency median reduced 140s -> 18s. GPUs releasing.

leo: OK cost-wise that's much cheaper than dedicated shift. please capture cost/time so we can quantify in postmortem.

claire: create a follow-up to add an automated route: if janitor_pending > 300 for >120s, temporarily divert new attaches to coldpool-dedicated-1 for affected tenants. tag: infra-routing.

vik: opened ticket INFRA-8721 for routing fallback + scrub scheduling blocker.

sam: re-enabled autoscale after 15m window. monitoring 30m now. will add a dashboard annotation for the scrub-tune change time.

opsbot: incident marked resolved by sam at 2026-03-23T09:28:27Z. Summary: throttled janitor, paused autoscale, increased attach concurrency, queue drained.

claire: thanks. leo, assigning postmortem to you for cost comparison + timeline. include recommendations: per-cohort rate limits, scrub/backfill scheduling, alert for janitor_pending >300.

leo: will do. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
